items.reason: Reports are written under <set>/verify/ with timestamped filenames.
Each completed verification writes once after fallback, preserving earlier reports.
The verdict-first contract remains; the report retains the remaining reply.
Parsing behavior is unchanged, and malformed replies retain their raw text.
Report writing applies to all three verdicts.
PASS now requires findings explaining checks and each criterion’s satisfaction.
Cache hits return before report writing.
Invalidation still deletes cached verdicts without deleting reports.
Reports never enter Verifier prompts; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Accept writes a human report without invoking an agent.
Human reports contain the rationale and overridden verdict.
Human reports explicitly identify their authorship.
Human reports use the same writer, headers, timestamp format, and latest-report lookup.
The gate preamble displays the latest report’s path and commit metadata without its prose.
The paging entry opens the report and returns to the gate.
The set detail view includes a Verify report pointer.
Verify artifacts rank above Refine artifacts.
Agent-facing views gain no pointer; golden changes cover only the Verifier response contract.
Missing reports produce no Verify-specific entries on the four surfaces.
Badge and verification-status derivation remain unchanged.
Status rows retain truncated findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; the pointer appears only in the separate detail view.
Both report families share parameterized rendering, filing, scanning, and header-reading machinery.
Refine delegates to shared machinery while preserving its existing formats and presentation.
Refine prompt goldens are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared design and focused regression tests; the missing status-row pointer leaves one acceptance gap. Assessment was static.
